name: trendsagi
description: Live trend intelligence for paid media and growth teams, via the hosted TrendsAGI MCP server at api.trendsagi.com. Find topics accelerating in your market before auctions get crowded, check whether a trend is still rising before committing budget, pull audience and marketing angles into ad copy, and act on evidence-backed recommendations. Read-only; sign in with your TrendsAGI account on first connect.

interface.shortDescription: Target rising demand: live trend velocity, audiences and ad angles for paid media teams.
interface.longDescription: TrendsAGI measures what is trending across social platforms in real time and turns it into evidence-backed recommendations. Ask Grok what is accelerating in your category, whether a trend is still rising or already fading before you move budget, which audiences and themes sit behind it, and which marketing angles to test - answered with TrendsAGI measurements, not guesses. Tools are read-only, count toward your plan's API limits, and each connection can be revoked from Profile > API Keys.
defaultPrompt: What is accelerating fastest in Technology this week, and who should I target with it?
Is this trend still rising or already fading? Should I scale spend on it?
Give me three ad angles for my product based on what is trending now.
